title: A Diagnosis Study of a New Prehospital Strokeidentification Test, the PreHospitalt Ambulans Stroke Test (PreHAST), to be Used to Triage Patients With Suspected Stroke
brief_summary: The aim of the Pre-HAST study is to improve identification and triage of patients with suspected stroke in order to get the right patient to the right level of care as fast as possible. Furthermore, the scale is also intended to use follow stroke symptoms in emergency care. The test is more extensive then the FAST or Cincinatti Stroke Scale and is in some aspects similar to the NIHSS but is shorter, easier and faster to perform to improve interexaminator variability and improve validity in less trained personal. The test is intended for awake patients with suspected stroke
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Suspected stroke

Exclusion Criteria:

* Unconscious
study_population: Patients with suspected stroke using pre hospital services in region Skåne, Sweden or being admited to Södersjukhuset in Stockholm, Sweden
